description: This walking tour explores the stories and development of different ways of travelling through Greenwich Old Town across time. For its distinctive physical, social and historical character, Greenwich offers surprisingly a rich landscape of journey-making. The tour follows routes by river, rail, road and time.

events.name: The making of journeys in Greenwich

factsheet.heading: Greenwich Journeys: River, Rail, Road and Time
paragraphs: Greenwich has always been a place of movement, connection, trade, history, science and discovery.  People have crossed, arrived, departed and passed through it.  It is shaped by journeys.

Along the path, we look at the Thames waterfront, old ferries, docks and the modern pier; the age of trams before buses; the role of Greenwich Power Station in powering local transport; the first passenger railway from London Bridge to Greenwich, carried above ground on viaducts; and the later underground connections of the Greenwich Foot Tunnel and the DLR.  A glimpse of aerial crossing adds a modern dimension to the story.

In one journey, we encounter the daily passage of dock workers, the royal crossings of the Thames, and the wider stories of sea navigation, adventure and exploration.  With pubs, public art and riverside views adding further richness, it offers a mix of hidden local history and spectacular vistas.  This walk invites you to experience Greenwich afresh, beyond its familiar landmarks.

factsheet.heading: Distance and duration of the tour
paragraphs: The route of the walking tour is about 2.5 km long and will last for about 2.5 hours

factsheet.heading: Golden Key Academy
paragraphs: The Golden Key Academy is a course training up insightful and engaging guides dedicated to explaining London and bringing its many stories to life. This tour is part of a wider collection of tours created by Golden Key Academy guides for the Open House Festival celebrating their conclusion of the eight month course.
Further information on the Golden Key Academy can be found here https://open-city.org.uk/golden-key-academy
If you would like to attend this tour, please ensure you have booked a ticket before turning up.
